scripts.build:cn: npm run tauri build && node scripts/rename-artifacts.mjs
scripts.build:win: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin:$PATH" && tauri build --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && node scripts/rename-artifacts.mjs
scripts.build:win:portable: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin:$PATH" && tauri build --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --no-bundle && node scripts/rename-artifacts.mjs
